description: Guard against foreign-CWD breakage and discovery loss for the vendored cc-thinking-skills reference library.

evals.task: Verify the vendored thinking-skills library is reachable from any project CWD via KBG_PLUGIN_ROOT and that harness-nav surfaces it

context.command:
set -euo pipefail
: "${KBG_PLUGIN_ROOT:?KBG_PLUGIN_ROOT is not set}"
echo "count=$(find "${KBG_PLUGIN_ROOT}/docs/reference/thinking-skills/skills" -maxdepth 2 -name SKILL.md | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "first_heading=$(awk '/^# /{print; exit}' "${KBG_PLUGIN_ROOT}/docs/reference/thinking-skills/skills/thinking-systems/SKILL.md")"
nav_json=$(python3 "${KBG_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/harness-nav/scripts/nav.py" --json "mental models")
nav_refs=$(echo "$nav_json" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(sum(1 for m in json.load(sys.stdin).get('matches',[]) if m.get('kind')=='reference'))")
if [ "$nav_refs" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "nav_has_reference=true"
else
  echo "nav_has_reference=false"
  exit 1
fi

evals.failure_pattern: reasoning-models access path is broken from a foreign CWD or harness-nav no longer surfaces reference docs
